source: Office for National Statistics Census 2021 (Open Government Licence)
tables_not_at_oa: TS007 (age by single year) — ONS did not publish at OA level; available at LSOA and above only
oa_centroids: OA_December_2021_EW_PWC_V4 (ONS Open Geography Portal, ArcGIS REST service)
method: Population-weighted OA centroids joined to v6 sector boundaries via point-in-polygon (ray casting, 0.2° grid index)
coverage: England and Wales only. Scottish areas have empty codes with explanatory note.
scotland_note: Census 2022 for Scotland is published by National Records of Scotland (nrscotland.gov.uk) using Output Zones (OZ). Broadly comparable to E&W OAs. A Scotland pipeline would require a separate OZ centroid download and Scotland postcode lookup.
